description: Verify that DUT silently discards an IPv4 packet whose Version field is anything other than 4 — receiver must reject foreign protocol versions (RFC 791 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
Negative companion to IPV4_VERSION_01. Version != 4 means a different protocol layout (or garbled bytes); the field offsets DUT relies on aren't valid, so the packet must be dropped before any further parsing.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: IPv4 packet with Version != 4 (e.g. Version=6 with IPv4 layout, or arbitrary non-4)

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: nothing

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any response.

[Fail condition]
Fail_dut_replied — DUT responded despite the foreign Version. Indicates the receive path skipped the Version check.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently dropped the foreign-Version packet — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_replied: DUT responded despite Version != 4 — Version check missing
